blocks.text: Needs review by a South African attorney before use. This is a drafting outline, not legal advice and not an approved document. The statutes and instruments named are pointers for the reviewer: POPIA (Act 4 of 2013) sections 20, 21 and 72; POPIA (Act 4 of 2013) section 34 (children).
1. Roles
The school is the responsible party. The company is the operator and processes only on the school’s documented instructions.
2. Subject matter and purposes
List the processing purposes. They must match the platform’s declared purposes and no others.
[Fill in: purpose list agreed with the school]
3. Categories of data

rows: [Fill in: retention decided by the school]

blocks.text: 4. Children’s information
The school confirms the lawful ground for processing learner information. The operator processes it only for the purposes in clause 2.
[Fill in: ground relied on, consent where needed; counsel to confirm]
5. Security safeguards

Describe the measures: tenant isolation in the database, role-based access, encryption in transit and at rest, audit ledger, de-identification before any model call. Refer to the information security policy (lib-infosec-policy).
[Fill in: any measure counsel wants stated or omitted]
6. Sub-processors
List sub-processors, the data each sees and where it is processed. Require the school’s notice of changes.
[Fill in: current sub-processor list from the architecture and cost records; do not guess]
7. Transfers outside South Africa
State whether any processing happens outside the country and the safeguard relied on.
[Fill in: hosting region and transfer basis; counsel to confirm]
8. Breach notification
The operator tells the school without undue delay. Refer to the breach SOP (lib-breach-sop).
[Fill in: notification window agreed with the school]
9. Data subject requests
The operator helps the school answer access, correction and deletion requests. Refer to lib-dsr-sop.
10. Audit
The school may ask for evidence of compliance.
[Fill in: audit scope and frequency]
11. Return and erasure
On termination return and erase, and issue a certificate (lib-data-return-erasure).
